annotations.title: Domain DNS + email security audit (SPF, DMARC)

description: Domain DNS and email-security audit: A/AAAA/NS/MX/TXT/CAA/SOA records, SPF problems, DMARC policy, MTA-STS, BIMI and DNSSEC with prioritized findings and a score. For deliverability checks, phishing/spoof risk and vendor due diligence. $0.003 USDC on Base via x402. Price: $0.003. First call returns the x402 PaymentRequired (no charge); retry with payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

x402_payment.description: Optional. Base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload, for clients that cannot set params._meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to get the exact price.
